scan.title: Scan a label
scan.intro: Point your camera at the front label. We read it and fill the wine in for you.
scan.tips: Good light, no glare, and the label filling the picture.
scan.privacy: To read the label, your photo is sent to our AI partner (OpenAI). Nothing else is shared, and the photo is kept in your own cellar.
scan.foundBody: This looks like a wine you already have.
scan.rememberedBody: You confirmed this exact photo before. Check it and confirm again.
scan.chooseBody: Your cellar has wines that look like this label.
scan.noneOfThese: None of these: it is a new wine
scan.newBody: Here is what we read from the label. Check it and fix whatever is off.
scan.hardToRead: Parts of this label were hard to read. Please check the details.
scan.typeUnclear: We couldn’t tell the kind of wine from the label. Choose it below.
scan.noConnection: No connection. Your photo is still here: try again when you are back online.

unread.ai-off: Reading labels isn’t switched on yet. Your photo is saved: fill the wine in below.
unread.ai-down: We couldn’t read this label just now. Your photo is saved: fill the wine in below, or try another photo.
unread.limit: You have scanned a lot in a short while. Your photo is saved: fill the wine in below.
unread.not-a-label: That doesn’t look like a wine label. Try another photo, or fill the wine in below.
unread.budget: Reading labels is paused for now. Your photo is saved: fill the wine in below.

series.intro: A photo per wine, one after another: we read them while you go on. Then check and add each.
series.title: Your batch
series.added: Added {count, plural, one {# bottle} other {# bottles}} of {wine}

series.heldHint: Kept aside: this looks like a photo you already added
series.duplicatePhoto: This is the same photo as photo {n}. It is not read again unless you say so.
series.sameWine: Same wine as photo {n}. Adding it adds more bottles of it; skip it if it is the same bottle.
series.full: A batch holds up to 20 photos. {count, plural, one {# photo was} other {# photos were}} not added.
series.summary: {added, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} added · {skipped} skipped · {failed} not read

camera.denied: CELLR may not use the camera. Allow it in your settings, or take the photo with the button below.
camera.unavailable: No live camera here. The button below opens your phone’s camera.

profile.title: Profile
profile.inviteBody: Share this code. It works for 7 days and for up to 5 people.
profile.inviteShareText: Join our wine cellar on CELLR with this code: {code}
profile.leaveConfirm: Leave {household}? You'll lose access to its cellar until someone invites you again.
profile.importBody: Moving from the Wijnkelder app? Bring your bottles, ratings and notes along.
profile.currencyHint: Used for the prices of bottles you add from now on. Prices already entered keep their own currency.
profile.deleteHouseholdBody: This removes every bottle, rating, note, photo and wish in {household}, for everyone in it. It cannot be undone. You may want to download your data first.
profile.deleteHouseholdConfirmLabel: Type the household’s name to confirm
profile.exportBody: A readable copy of everything: bottles, ratings, wishlist and places, as one file you can keep.
profile.exportFailed: We couldn’t prepare your data. Try again.
profile.deleteAccountBody: This deletes your sign-in and everything that is only yours, such as your favourites and your ratings. A household only you are in is deleted too, with all its bottles and photos. Households you share with others are left, and keep their cellars.
profile.deleteAccountConfirmLabel: Type your email address to confirm

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.body: Get a notification on this phone when a wine in your cellar reaches its best years, and when it is time to drink it soon.
reminders.switchedOn: Reminders are on for this phone.
reminders.switchedOff: Reminders are off for this phone.
reminders.failed: That didn’t work. Try again in a moment.
reminders.denied: Notifications are blocked for CELLR. Allow them in your phone’s settings, then come back here.
reminders.unsupported: This browser can’t show notifications. On an iPhone: add CELLR to your home screen (Share → Add to Home Screen), open it from there and turn this on.

profile.leaveAlone: You're the only one in this household, so it can't be left behind empty. To stop using it, delete it under Household settings.
profile.leaveLastOwner: You're the only owner, and others share this cellar. To leave, remove them first, or delete the household under Household settings.

catalog.title: Help improve the shared wine list
catalog.body: When you add a bottle you confirmed, its name, colour and origin may count towards CELLR's shared list of wines, so others recognise it faster. Only counts are kept: nobody can see that it was you.
catalog.never: Never shared: your photos, bottles, prices, notes, ratings or anything else in your cellar.
catalog.isOff: You are not helping (your earlier contributions were removed).
catalog.switchedOn: Thank you: your confirmed wines now help.
catalog.switchedOff: Stopped. What you contributed was removed.
catalog.scanNote: When you add the wine, its name, colour and origin may help CELLR's shared wine list (never the photo or your cellar). You can turn this off in Profile.

drink.title: When to drink it

explain.young: Give it time: its window opens in {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}}.
explain.developing: It is starting to open up and will get better still.
explain.peak: This is the stretch it was made for. Now is a good moment.

explain.past: Past the best of its window, by the estimate. Bottles can surprise: open it soon.
explain.unknown: A non-vintage wine has no year to count from, so there is no window to follow.

import.title: Bring your cellar over
import.subtitle: From the Wijnkelder app, with your bottles, spots, ratings and notes.
import.step1: In the Wijnkelder app, open its settings and make a backup. You get a small file.
import.step2: Choose that file here. First we only read it, and show you what would come over.
import.step3: Happy with it? Confirm, and your cellar is here in a moment.
import.privacy: The file is read on your phone. Only what is needed is sent, and only to your own cellar.
import.notJson: That doesn’t look like a backup file. Choose the .json file the Wijnkelder app made.
import.notWijnkelder: That file isn’t a Wijnkelder backup. Choose the file the Wijnkelder app made.
import.tooBig: That backup is too large to bring over in one go. Remove some old history in the Wijnkelder app and try again.
import.unplaced: {count, plural, one {# bottle has no spot yet} other {# bottles have no spot yet}}. You can place {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} later.
import.scaleQuestion: What were your old scores out of?
import.scaleHint: We worked it out from your scores. Change it if we got it wrong; everything becomes half stars.
import.nothingToBring: There is nothing to bring over
import.onlyOnce: Do this once. Doing it again would add everything a second time.
import.doneBody: {bottles, plural, one {# bottle} other {# bottles}} now in your cellar, {opened, plural, =0 {none} other {# more}} already opened, with {tastings, plural, =0 {no ratings} one {# rating or note} other {# ratings and notes}}.
import.tastingsSkipped: Your ratings and notes are waiting for one more database step before they can be kept. Everything else came over. The setup guide, “Updating the database”, shows what to do.

warning.country-unknown: {count, plural, one {# wine has} other {# wines have}} a country we didn’t recognise, like “{example}”. They come over without a country.
warning.year-invalid: {count, plural, one {# vintage was} other {# vintages were}} not a real year, like {example}. Those bottles come over as non-vintage.
warning.producer-missing: {count, plural, one {# wine has} other {# wines have}} no producer, like “{example}”. They are filed under “Unknown producer”.
warning.type-unknown: {count, plural, one {# wine has} other {# wines have}} a colour we didn’t recognise, like {example}. They are set to red; you can change that.
warning.price-invalid: {count, plural, one {# price} other {# prices}} could not be read, like {example}. They are left empty.
warning.date-invalid: {count, plural, one {# date} other {# dates}} could not be read, like {example}.
warning.format-unknown: {count, plural, one {# bottle size} other {# bottle sizes}} we didn’t recognise, like “{example}”. They count as 75 cl.
warning.quantity-capped: {count, plural, one {# wine has} other {# wines have}} an enormous number of bottles, like {example}. At most 200 per wine come over.
warning.rack-too-big: {count, plural, one {# rack is} other {# racks are}} bigger than the biggest we can draw, like {example}. The bottles that don’t fit have no spot yet.
warning.spot-taken: {count, plural, one {# bottle shared} other {# bottles shared}} a spot, like {example}. They took the next free one.
